answer: Locks are written down in violet, expire in bridge, and vine lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 22 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An adversary running 20 aliases therefore needs 34 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1816 identities would post 2102 proofs and burn roughly 68 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
